01 — About

A little bit about me.

Bagian ini nanti kita isi dengan cerita personalmu: siapa kamu, apa yang kamu kerjakan, dan apa yang membuatmu tertarik pada bidangmu.

I'm a Bachelor of Informatics graduate from Tanjungpura University with hands-on experience in Android app development, React web development, backend such as Firebase, Node.Js, and data analysis. I've also got a solid grasp of machine learning, which helps me dive deeper into working with data. I'm always excited to sharpen my technical skills and stay open to opportunities where I can not only refine what I already know and pick up new tools and technologies. Lately, I've been exploring React for web and data projects, expanding my web development skill set, and diving into data analytics and data science. I'm passionate about projects that foster innovation, teamwork, and creative problem-solving. I'm on the lookout for a role where I can leverage my skills in app development, React, and data analytics, while continuously growing and adapting to the fast-moving tech world.
